authority: Executable source bundle for the Phase 4 same-source presentation system. Extract into visual/assets before running; the package intentionally stores source as JSON because the submission whitelist permits JSON but not .mjs or .py.
instructions: Extract each source field to its restore_as filename under visual/assets using UTF-8 LF bytes.
Run phase4-font-subset.py with pinned fontTools 4.63.0 and Brotli 1.2.0 first, then phase4-presentation-generator.mjs.

For a clean committed candidate, run phase4-font-subset.py and immediately run phase4-presentation-generator.mjs --check before any generator rewrite; this must reproduce the committed font-subset.css and all 12 output hashes.

For strict byte-idempotence evidence, repeat the complete font-to-generator chain in two fresh copies and require font-subset.css plus all 12 generated outputs to match each other and the candidate commit byte-for-byte.
Do not run if any phase4-source-freeze.json authority or repository hash fails.

from __future__ import annotations

"""Regenerate the offline Phase 4 Noto Sans SC regular/bold web subsets."""

import argparse
import base64
import hashlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import tempfile
import urllib.request

import brotli
import fontTools
from fontTools import subset
from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
from fontTools.varLib.instancer import instantiateVariableFont


SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve()
SUBMISSION = SCRIPT.parents[2]
OUTPUT = SCRIPT.parent / "font-subset.css"
FONT_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/Sans2.004/Sans/Variable/TTF/Subset/NotoSansSC-VF.ttf"
FONT_SHA256 = "d68bafcb48a2707749396aa12bbbd833cb70401f3a9a689fd2902c7e0d295964"
FONT_LICENSE_URL = "https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/blob/main/Sans/LICENSE"
EXPECTED_FONTTOOLS_VERSION = "4.63.0"
EXPECTED_BROTLI_VERSION = "1.2.0"
FIXED_OPENTYPE_TIMESTAMP = 2082840000
TEXT_INPUTS = (
    SCRIPT.parent / "phase4-presentation-sources.json",
    SCRIPT.parent / "phase4-figure-registry.json",
    SCRIPT.parent / "phase4-layout-contract.json",
    SCRIPT.parent / "phase4-presentation-audit.json",
    SCRIPT.parent / "phase3-protocol-contracts.json",
    SCRIPT.parent / "phase3-red-team.json",
    SUBMISSION / "report" / "proposal.html",
    SUBMISSION / "report" / "proposal.en.html",
    SUBMISSION / "visual" / "index.html",
    SUBMISSION / "visual" / "index.en.html",
)


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def assert_toolchain() -> dict[str, str]:
    versions = {
        "fontTools": fontTools.__version__,
        "Brotli": brotli.__version__,
    }
    expected = {
        "fontTools": EXPECTED_FONTTOOLS_VERSION,
        "Brotli": EXPECTED_BROTLI_VERSION,
    }
    if versions != expected:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Font toolchain drift: actual={versions}, expected={expected}")
    return versions


def assert_final_css_woff2_heads(path: Path, expected_timestamp: int) -> dict[str, object]:
    css = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    payloads = re.findall(r"base64,([^)]*)\) format\('woff2'\)", css)
    if len(payloads) != 2:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected two WOFF2 payloads in final CSS, found {len(payloads)}")
    fonts: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for weight, payload in zip((400, 700), payloads, strict=True):
        raw = base64.b64decode(payload, validate=True)
        font = TTFont(io.BytesIO(raw), recalcTimestamp=False)
        created = int(font["head"].created)
        modified = int(font["head"].modified)
        record = {
            "weight": weight,
            "woff2_bytes": len(raw),
            "woff2_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            "head.created": created,
            "head.modified": modified,
        }
        fonts.append(record)
        if (created, modified) != (expected_timestamp, expected_timestamp):
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Final CSS WOFF2 weight {weight} raw head timestamps "
                f"{created}/{modified}, expected {expected_timestamp}/{expected_timestamp}"
            )
    return {
        "source": path.name,
        "decoded_payloads": len(payloads),
        "expected_timestamp": expected_timestamp,
        "fonts": fonts,
        "ok": True,
    }


def acquire_font(target: Path) -> None:
    request = urllib.request.Request(FONT_URL, headers={"User-Agent": "jingzhang-phase4-font-builder/1"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=120) as response:
        target.write_bytes(response.read())
    actual = sha256(target)
    if actual != FONT_SHA256:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Noto source SHA-256 mismatch: {actual}")


def phase4_characters() -> str:
    missing = [str(path) for path in TEXT_INPUTS if not path.is_file()]
    if missing:
        raise FileNotFoundError("Missing Phase 4 text inputs: " + ", ".join(missing))
    text = "".join(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for path in TEXT_INPUTS)
    text += "\n\t 0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    return "".join(sorted(set(text)))


def static_font(variable_path: Path, weight: int, target: Path) -> None:
    variable = TTFont(str(variable_path), recalcTimestamp=False)
    static = instantiateVariableFont(variable, {"wght": weight}, inplace=False, optimize=True)
    static.recalcTimestamp = False
    static["head"].created = FIXED_OPENTYPE_TIMESTAMP
    static["head"].modified = FIXED_OPENTYPE_TIMESTAMP
    static.save(str(target), reorderTables=False)


def subset_woff2(ttf_path: Path, characters: str, target: Path) -> None:
    font = TTFont(str(ttf_path), recalcTimestamp=False)
    options = subset.Options()
    options.flavor = "woff2"
    options.layout_features = ["*"]
    options.name_IDs = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 13, 14]
    options.name_legacy = True
    options.name_languages = [0x409, 0x804]
    subsetter = subset.Subsetter(options=options)
    subsetter.populate(text=characters)
    subsetter.subset(font)
    font.recalcTimestamp = False
    font["head"].created = FIXED_OPENTYPE_TIMESTAMP
    font["head"].modified = FIXED_OPENTYPE_TIMESTAMP
    font.flavor = "woff2"
    font.save(str(target), reorderTables=False)


def css_payload(regular: Path, bold: Path, glyph_count: int) -> str:
    regular64 = base64.b64encode(regular.read_bytes()).decode("ascii")
    bold64 = base64.b64encode(bold.read_bytes()).decode("ascii")
    return f"""/*
Noto Sans SC 2.004 offline subsets for Jing-Zhang In Situ Phase 4.
Source: {FONT_URL}
Source SHA-256: {FONT_SHA256}
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 ({FONT_LICENSE_URL})
Character set: {glyph_count} unique Unicode code points from the Phase 4 generator, registry, audit, and four HTML outputs.
Generated with pinned fontTools 4.63.0 and Brotli 1.2.0; no operating-system font is required at runtime.
WOFF2 byte reproducibility: the raw final WOFF2 OpenType head.created/head.modified values are fixed at 2082840000; timestamp recalculation is disabled before each save and the final CSS payloads are decoded and asserted after writing.
*/
@font-face{{font-family:'JZ Noto Sans SC';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,{regular64}) format('woff2')}}
@font-face{{font-family:'JZ Noto Sans SC';font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,{bold64}) format('woff2')}}
"""


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="decode the final CSS WOFF2 payloads and verify the pinned toolchain/timestamps")
    parser.add_argument("--negative-font-timestamp", action="store_true", help="read-only negative fixture: expect a deliberately wrong timestamp")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    versions = assert_toolchain()
    expected_timestamp = FIXED_OPENTYPE_TIMESTAMP + int(args.negative_font_timestamp)
    if args.check or args.negative_font_timestamp:
        report = assert_final_css_woff2_heads(OUTPUT, expected_timestamp)
        report["toolchain"] = versions
        print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        return

    characters = phase4_characters()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="jingzhang-phase4-font-") as tmp_name:
        tmp = Path(tmp_name)
        variable = tmp / "NotoSansSC-VF.ttf"
        acquire_font(variable)
        regular_ttf = tmp / "JZNoto-Regular.ttf"
        bold_ttf = tmp / "JZNoto-Bold.ttf"
        regular_woff2 = tmp / "JZNoto-Regular.woff2"
        bold_woff2 = tmp / "JZNoto-Bold.woff2"
        static_font(variable, 400, regular_ttf)
        static_font(variable, 700, bold_ttf)
        subset_woff2(regular_ttf, characters, regular_woff2)
        subset_woff2(bold_ttf, characters, bold_woff2)
        OUTPUT.write_text(css_payload(regular_woff2, bold_woff2, len(characters)), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    head_assertions = assert_final_css_woff2_heads(OUTPUT, FIXED_OPENTYPE_TIMESTAMP)
    print(json.dumps({
        "output": str(OUTPUT),
        "characters": len(characters),
        "source_sha256": FONT_SHA256,
        "css_sha256": sha256(OUTPUT),
        "toolchain": versions,
        "final_woff2_head_assertions": head_assertions,
    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
